slug: 2025-10-27 Cameroon's BUNEC partners with Liber Technologies for CRVS digitization

facts.fact: BUNEC, the national civil status registration office, partnered in October 2025 with the Luxembourg firm Liber Technologies to speed the digital transformation of civil registration under Law 2024/016, and aims for a fully digital system by 2029; the text names no plan document and no financing.

Law 2024/016, which the BUNEC and Liber Technologies partnership of October 2025 is to implement, authorises digital birth, marriage and death certificates and a unique personal identification number for every citizen; this is what the law permits, not a statement of what offices do.

systems.country_label: CRVS digital transformation; fully digital CRVS system by 2029
systems.owner: BUNEC, with Liber Technologies as partner
systems.tiers: national aim for 2029; no offices named

systems.system: integration of civil registration with the biometric national ID and biometric voter kits

note: The held text is a two-paragraph summary merging two reports of the same partnership.
